_about: Write the Houdini hand-off for analysis layers (population and the like): site-model/houdini/handoff/. See the docstring of site-model/houdini/tools/export_handoff.py.
source: USGS 3DEP CA_LosAngeles_B23 (2023) LiDAR at full density with the Houdini labels (the same names as web/data/lidar_points.laz); entities, names and Assessor data from site-model/houdini/annotations/entities.json
axes: x = east, y = north, z = up (local, from the origin)
tiers_note: Buildings with 'outlines': 'per height' have stacked tiers, one outline every 3 m from the building's own points (walls and roofs), each tier from 'base' to 'top' on the tier below, 'ground' = the building's ground; each outline stays within the roof tiers standing at its height. The others (too few points) keep roof tiers: a prism from 'base' (ground, 10th percentile under it) to 'top' (90th percentile of its 1 m roof cells), cut where roof heights jump more than 2 m, not overlapping. Only the part of a building inside the extent is included.

terrain.note: value at the centre of each cell; row 0 = north, column 0 = west; x0 / y0 = the NW cell centre
terrain.filled_cells: 0.2% had no points and take the nearest measured cell
